_note: Visual wireframe references for Stage 4 HTML templates. Each PNG shows a layout blueprint. implemented=true means a tpl_<id>() function exists in adgen/render/templates.py.

r01.name: Product split — photo right
r01.use_case: E-commerce product with feature icons and delivery info. Light/neutral brands.

r02.name: Problem-solution split — photo left, dark panel right
r02.use_case: E-commerce or service: product photo left, copy+CTA on dark right panel. Problem/solution framing.

r03.name: Transformation — before/after with centre product
r03.use_case: Before/after transformation. Product shot flanked by BEFORE/AFTER labels. Feature list left.

r04.name: Hexagon tech — diagonal split
r04.use_case: Tech / sports / automotive. Bold black+orange, diagonal divider, hexagonal photo frames.

r05.name: Hexagon tech — compact variant
r05.use_case: Compact version of r04. Same bold tech aesthetic but tighter layout.

r06.name: Before/after — full-width hero photo
r06.use_case: Transformation product. Wide hero photo with BEFORE/AFTER labels; feature pills; full-width CTA.

r07.name: Product features — dark compact
r07.use_case: Compact dark ad: amber headline/tagline, feature list left, product photo right.

r08.name: Multi-line headline — dark compact
r08.use_case: Compact dark layout. 4-line alternating-colour headline (white/orange), features + hexagon product detail.

r09.name: Hexagon eco — large scene + detail
r09.use_case: Sustainability or outdoor brand. 5-line headline, two hexagonal photo zones, eco benefit line.

t01.name: Price anchor — cream editorial
t01.use_case: Premium B2B or high-ticket offer. Cream background, amber price as hero element, editorial corner brackets.

t11.name: Construction tape — benefit checklist
t11.use_case: B2B direct-response. Construction-tape border, dark quadrant photo zone, 5 bold checkbox benefits.

t12.name: Construction tape — app/software offer
t12.use_case: Software or app with industrial aesthetic. Yellow offer box, app UI mockup, construction-tape border.

t13.name: Free product — qualifier shock
t13.use_case: Lead magnet / free offer. Qualifier badge targets niche, 'FREE PRODUKTS.' dominates, strikethrough value.

t15.name: Stats-forward B2B — italic headline
t15.use_case: B2B service with strong social proof. Stats bar (revenue/clients/countries), italic editorial headline, free bonus at bottom.

t20.name: Bold split — orange + dark
t20.use_case: High-energy B2B. Curved diagonal split: grayscale photo left, orange panel right with stats and CTA.

t21.name: Elegant B2B — cream with testimonial
t21.use_case: Sophisticated B2B consulting or coaching. Cream tone, testimonial, numbered benefits, elegant serif type.

t22.name: Red alert — selection urgency
t22.use_case: Urgent/exclusive offer targeting a niche. Red construction tape, selection badge, lightning bolts.

t25.name: Wanted poster — free offer
t25.use_case: Attention-grabbing 'WANTED' poster gimmick for free lead magnet. Qualification gatekeeping.

t33.name: Diagonal stripe — photo top, copy bottom
t33.use_case: B2B with lifestyle photo. Orange diagonal stripe cuts across, social proof badge overlaps stripe.

t34.name: Event — dark minimal with testimonial
t34.use_case: Workshop or event. Serif italic headline, event type pills, testimonial, limited-spots urgency strip.

t43.name: Free lead magnet — editorial dark
t43.use_case: Premium free offer. 'Nr.01 FREE PRODUCT/SERVICE' in gold/white, two moody photo zones.

t47.name: Free product — qualifier shock v2
t47.use_case: Variant of t13. Same qualifier+free-offer layout with orange/white colour scheme.

t48.name: Free offer — dark compact
t48.use_case: Compact free-offer card targeting qualifying businesses. Minimal layout, no photos.

t50.name: Free offer — centred dark minimal
t50.use_case: Centred typographic free-offer. Italic editorial headline above dominant FREE, amber accent.

t51.name: Benefit checklist — dark with free offer footer
t51.use_case: B2B benefits-first layout. Checkbox benefits dominate, free product in footer, orange corner accent.

t53.name: Lead notification — card overlay
t53.use_case: Lead-gen proof. 'New lead' notification card floating over photo, rounded pill card at bottom.

t54.name: Arch photo — dark elegant
t54.use_case: Premium service or consulting. Arched photo frame, large serif+italic mixed headline, feature chips.

t62.name: Workshop — time-savings dark compact
t62.use_case: Workshop or course. 'OLD METHOD' strikethrough → new time/result value. Event details pill.

t63.name: Workshop — event announcement dark compact
t63.use_case: Event / workshop announcement. Compact serif headline, event details pill (in-person/online/date/price).
